Done — I turned the Habit tracker’s App side into a playful **Tiny Victory Garden**:

- Today’s habits are now “quests” with plant icons.
- Completing habits grows the garden and updates the score.
- Finishing all habits triggers confetti.
- Added **Today / Garden / Map** sections.
- Added weekly progress, streaks, badges, and a 14-day map.
- Added App Settings for garden name, weekly goal, and style.
- Fixed the preview spacing/readability issues and rechecked it — the app passes Amber’s checks.

Your note’s table/text was left unchanged.
